Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results provided by the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer correctly identified the Battle of Peleliu dates as "15 September to 27 November 1944" based on the visible text from Wikipedia and History.com. However, the Planner hallucinated the year as "1914" instead of "1944," leading to the false conclusion that the Battle of Peleliu occurred earlier than the Battle of Belleau Wood (1918). This factual error in data extraction/interpretation by the Planner caused the wrong final answer.
